user.title: Connect to your Kessil dongle
user.description: Enter the IP address of the Kessil WiFi dongle on your network. A static DHCP lease is recommended, as the integration does not discover address changes on its own.

data_description.port: Leave at 8888 unless you have changed it

reconfigure.title: Update your Kessil dongle connection
reconfigure.description: Point this dongle at a new address.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the dongle. Check the IP address and that the dongle is powered on.

abort.already_configured: This dongle is already set up.
abort.wrong_device: That address belongs to a different Kessil dongle.
